hints.title: Dimensionality Inspection
hints.text: Every tabular dataset carries metadata describing its row count and column count. Which built-in attribute exposes these dimensions as a tuple?

hints.title: Shape Attribute Extraction
hints.text: The shape property returns a two-element tuple containing the number of rows and columns. Converting this tuple into a list satisfies the requirement.

hints.title: Tuple Casting to List
hints.text: Access players.shape to retrieve (rows, cols) and wrap it with list() to return [rows, cols].

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Constant-time metadata inspection of underlying DataFrame block geometry.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Iterating through rows or computing lengths of every Series costs O(R) time instead of O(1).
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Reading existing DataFrame metadata requires zero additional memory.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Direct utilization of DataFrame.shape attribute without manually scanning indices.
